--access-key.help: Kubescape SaaS access key. Default will load access key from cache

--account.help: Kubescape SaaS account ID. Default will load account ID from cache

--action.help: Action to take when policy fails

--api-version.help: API version of the workload (e.g. apps/v1). Default will be empty.

--base-path.help: Restrict fixes to this directory: the report's own recorded scan location must resolve inside it. Use this when the report file comes from a source you don't fully trust (e.g. a shared CI artifact); without it, the report's recorded location is trusted as-is

--chart-path.help: Path to the helm chart the workload is part of. Must be used with --file-path.

--cluster-name.help: Set the custom name of the cluster. Not same as the kube-context flag

--compliance-threshold.help: Compliance threshold is the percent below which the command fails and returns exit code 1. Applies to 'scan framework', 'scan control', and '--view resource|control'

--confirm.help: perform the real cluster write; without it the action is a dry-run preview

--container-profile.help: Path to a JSON file containing a ContainerProfile to use for drift detection

--control.help: Kubescape control ID to bind resources to

--control-timeout.help: Maximum duration for evaluating a single control (e.g. 30s, 1m). 0 means no timeout. Controls that exceed this are marked as not evaluated and the scan continues. Must be lower than --scan-timeout when both are set.

--controls-config.help: Path to an controls-config obj. If not set will download controls-config from ARMO management portal

--controls-version.help: Pin the regolibrary release tag used to download controls (see https://github.com/kubescape/regolibrary/releases). If not used will download the latest release. Has no effect when --account is set (cloud backend is used instead)

--dry-run.help: No changes will be applied (default false)

--enable-host-scan.help: Deploy Kubescape host-sensor daemonset in the scanned cluster. Deleting it right after we collecting the data. Required to collect valuable data from cluster nodes for certain controls. Yaml file: https://github.com/kubescape/kubescape/blob/master/core/pkg/hostsensorutils/hostsensor.yaml

--enable-rego-prints.help: Enable sending to rego prints to the logs (use with debug log level: -l debug)

--enable-streaming.help: Enable resource streaming for large clusters to reduce memory usage. Resources are processed in batches instead of loading all at once. Automatically enabled for clusters with >2500 resources.

--encrypt.help: Encrypt sensitive report metadata using the KUBESCAPE_MASTER_KEY environment variable

--env.help: 'env' is no longer supported, Use 'server' instead.

--environment.help: 'environment' is no longer supported, Use 'server' instead.

--exceptions.help: Path to an exceptions obj. If not set will download exceptions from ARMO management portal

--exclude-namespaces.help: Namespaces to exclude from scanning. e.g: --exclude-namespaces ns-a,ns-b. Notice, when running with `exclude-namespace` kubescape does not scan cluster-scoped objects.

--fail-coverage-below.help: Fail (exit code 1) when the scan coverage score drops below this percentage (0 to disable). The score is the ratio of evaluated controls discounted by 3 points per silent failed GVR pull (a resource type that failed to collect entirely but whose dependent controls still evaluated via other resource types), 2 points per partial GVR pull, and 5 points per degraded policy input, so a scan with every control evaluated can still fail on partial resource collection or fallback policy inputs

--fail-on-degraded-config.help: Fail the scan (exit code 1) if control configurations or exceptions could not be loaded from their configured source and bundled defaults were used instead

--fail-on-new.help: Exit with code 1 when new failures are found (combine with --severity-threshold to limit the gate)

--fail-threshold.help: Failure threshold is the percent above which the command fails and returns exit code 1. Applies to 'scan framework', 'scan control', and '--view resource|control'

--finding-ref.help: scan-result reference that justifies the action, e.g. workloadconfigurationscansummaries/payments/api

--format-version.help: Output object can be different between versions, this is for maintaining backward and forward compatibility. Supported:'v1'/'v2'

--frameworks.help: Load frameworks for configuration scanning (default: all)

--from-release.help: Download the library from this cel-admission-library release tag (e.g. v0.11) instead of using the embedded copy

--hide.help: Replace sensitive report metadata with deterministic pseudonyms

--host-scan-yaml.help: Override default host scanner DaemonSet. Use this flag cautiously

--id.help: Control ID's are included in list outputs

--ignore-errors.help: Ignore errors and continue patching other images. Default to false

--image.help: Application image name and tag to patch

--image-scan-concurrency.help: Number of concurrent workers for image scanning

--include-empty.help: Include empty values in the rendered output

--keep-local.help: If you do not want your Kubescape results reported to configured backend.

--kind.help: target workload kind: Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet or Pod

--kube-context.help: Kube context. Default will use the current-context

--kubeconfig.help: Path to the kubeconfig file. If not set, in-cluster config is used or $HOME/.kube/config if outside a cluster.

--label-selector.help: Filter collected Kubernetes resources by label selector. Accepts any selector that kubectl -l supports, e.g: --label-selector app=nginx,env!=dev

--labels-to-copy.help: Labels to copy from workloads to scan reports for easy identification. e.g: --labels-to-copy=app,team,environment

--no-confirm.help: No confirmation will be given to the user before applying the fix (default false)

--omit-raw-resources.help: Omit raw resources from the output. By default the raw resources are included in the output

--only-fixable.help: When used with --severity-threshold on image scans, only count CVEs that have an available fix toward the pass/fail decision

--output.help: Output format: text, json, or yaml

--output-mode.help: Output mode for the patched image (docker, image, oci, local)

--output-path.help: Destination path for oci or local output mode

--policy.help: Name of the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy to bind resources to

--push.help: Push the patched image to the source registry. Default to false (the patched image is only loaded into the local image store). If set, this overrides output-mode to 'image'.

--reason.help: human-readable justification recorded in the audit trail

--registry-authority.help: Registry host[:port] the --scan-images credentials apply to

--registry-mapping.help: Map internal registry hosts to reachable ones, e.g. --registry-mapping image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000=registry.company.com (host[:port], no scheme)

--registry-password.help: Password for image registry login when no docker config or credential helper is available; can also be set with KUBESCAPE_REGISTRY_PASSWORD

--registry-token.help: Bearer token for image registry login when no docker config or credential helper is available; can also be set with KUBESCAPE_REGISTRY_TOKEN

--registry-username.help: Username for image registry login when no docker config or credential helper is available; can also be set with KUBESCAPE_REGISTRY_USERNAME

--release-name.help: Helm release name made available as .Release.Name when rendering the chart

--release-namespace.help: Helm release namespace made available as .Release.Namespace when rendering the chart

--scan-timeout.help: Maximum duration for the scan (e.g. 5m, 30s, 1h). 0 means no timeout. When the timeout is reached the scan exits with a non-zero code.

--set.help: Set Helm values on the command line when scanning a Helm chart (can specify multiple, e.g. --set key1=val1 --set key2=val2)

--set-file.help: Set Helm values from respective files specified via the command line (can specify multiple)

--set-string.help: Set Helm STRING values on the command line when scanning a Helm chart (can specify multiple)

--severity-threshold.help: Only count failures at or above this severity when using --fail-on-new (low, medium, high, critical)

--skip-user-values.help: Changes which involve user-defined values will be skipped

--submit.help: Submit the scan results to Kubescape SaaS where you can see the results in a user-friendly UI, choose your preferred compliance framework, check risk results history and trends, manage exceptions, get remediation recommendations and much more. By default the results are not submitted

--tag.help: Tag for the patched image. Defaults to '<image-tag>-patched'

--timeout.help: Timeout for the operation, defaults to '5m'

--use-artifacts-from.help: Load artifacts from local directory. If not used will download them

--use-default.help: Load local policy object from default path. If not used will download latest

--use-default-matchers.help: Use default matchers (true) or CPE matchers (false) for image scanning

--use-from.help: Load local policy object from specified path. If not used will download latest

--values.help: Specify Helm values in a YAML file or a URL when scanning a Helm chart (can specify multiple, or separate paths with commas)

--verbose.help: Display full report. Default to false

configurations.help: Trigger configuration scanning from the Kubescape Operator microservice

decrypt.help: Decrypt report metadata encrypted with kubescape scan --encrypt

deploy-library.help: Install Kubescape CEL admission policy library

diff.help: Compare two Kubescape scan JSON reports and show what changed

fix.help: Propose a fix for the misconfiguration found when scanning Kubernetes manifest files

framework.help: Execute a scan on a running Kubernetes cluster or `yaml`/`json` files (use glob) or `-` for stdin

kubescape.help: Kubescape is a tool for testing Kubernetes security posture. Docs: https://kubescape.io/docs/

list.help: List frameworks/controls will list the supported frameworks and controls

operator.help: The operator is used to communicate with the Kubescape Operator within the cluster components.

patch.help: Patch container images to fix known OS-level vulnerabilities

prerequisites.help: Check prerequisites for installing Kubescape Operator

remediate.help: Act on scan findings via the Kubescape Operator (annotate, quarantine, revert — dry-run by default)

scan.help: Scan your cluster using the Kubescape-operator within the cluster components

vap.help: Helper commands for managing Validating Admission Policies in a Kubernetes cluster

vulnerabilities.help: Scan your cluster for vulnerabilities using the Kubescape Operator in-cluster components

workload.help: Scan a workload for misconfigurations and image vulnerabilities
